articles.title: FTC Catches Martin Shkreli Trading 60+ Pharma Stocks Despite Lifetime Ban — Contempt Motion Filed
articles.summary: The FTC and seven states allege that Martin Shkreli, barred for life from the pharmaceutical industry, secretly traded stocks in at least 60 drug companies in direct violation of a federal court order. Regulators are now seeking a contempt finding and demanding he forfeit all trading profits. This is the predictable outcome of a system that never cleaned up the deeper rot Shkreli embodied — he was the symptom, not the disease.

articles.title: Beta Bionics Hid iLet Device Safety Failures From Investors — Stock Collapses 37%, Fraud Suit Filed
articles.summary: Beta Bionics allegedly misled investors about the safety, efficacy, and commercial viability of its iLet medical device, triggering FDA compliance scrutiny and a securities fraud class action after shares cratered over 37%. The case exposes a pattern where medical device companies obscure safety signals until market pressure forces the truth out. Patients and investors were both left holding the bag.

articles.title: Ensign Group Concealed Patient Neglect, Manipulated Staffing Data, and Ran Illegal Billing Schemes — Securities Fraud Suit Follows
articles.summary: Ensign Group, a major care facility operator, allegedly concealed systemic patient neglect, falsified quality and staffing metrics, engaged in improper billing, and ran an administrator-license rental scheme — all while assuring investors everything was fine. A securities fraud suit was filed after the stock dropped 8% when the truth began surfacing. The real victims aren't shareholders — they're the patients left in understaffed facilities.

articles.title: FTC Sues Hims & Hers: Telehealth Darling Accused of Deceptive Practices as Securities Fraud Class Action Piles On
articles.summary: The FTC has filed a sweeping federal complaint against Hims & Hers Health, accusing the company of deceptive conduct — now compounded by a securities fraud class action alleging executives hid the regulatory risk from investors as the stock plunged. The company built its brand on disrupting broken healthcare, but appears to have replicated its worst habits. When the FTC becomes the sheriff, you know regulatory capture has limits — sometimes.

articles.title: Pancreatic Cancer Cells Continuously Rewrite Their Genome to Evade Treatment — Half a Million Cells Analyzed
articles.summary: A landmark analysis of nearly 500,000 cells from dozens of pancreatic tumor patients reveals that cancer cells are continuously and dynamically reshaping their genetic identity — not just mutating once — enabling them to outmaneuver every therapeutic intervention thrown at them. This finding directly challenges the static tumor model that has guided oncology drug development for decades. The question the mainstream won't ask: how much chemo resistance has been driven by this phenomenon all along?

articles.title: Forced Psychiatric Treatment vs. Bodily Autonomy: The Government's 'We Know Best' Power Grab
articles.summary: A Reason analysis confronts the growing legal and ethical push to compel psychiatric treatment on individuals deemed mentally ill — regardless of their consent — raising the foundational question of whether a diagnosis strips a person of the right to refuse drugs. This is precisely the mechanism by which psychiatry has historically been weaponized: pathologize dissent, then mandate compliance. The coercion infrastructure is being built in plain sight.

articles.title: Accidental Live Vaccines in 220 Immunocompromised IBD Patients: Zero Disease Outcomes — So Why Is the Ban Still Absolute?
articles.summary: A real-world study found zero cases of measles, mumps, or chickenpox following accidental administration of live vaccines to 220 IBD patients on immune-modifying biologics — the exact population considered most at risk and categorically excluded from live vaccines by official guidelines. The data directly challenges the blanket prohibition that has left immunocompromised patients unprotected for years. When evidence contradicts dogma, medicine should update its dogma — not bury the study.

articles.title: GDF15 Deficiency in the Placenta Causes Fetal Growth Restriction — Pregnancy Biology the Guidelines Ignore
articles.summary: New research demonstrates that placenta-specific GDF15 is essential for fetal growth, operating through the fetal hepatic STAT3-IGF2 signaling axis — and that deficiency of this factor directly causes fetal growth restriction in mice, with clinical correlates in human pregnancies. This mechanistic pathway has received almost no attention in mainstream obstetric guidelines or prenatal care protocols. Understanding what the placenta is actually doing biochemically could transform how we prevent fetal growth restriction — if anyone is listening.

articles.title: Doctors and Researchers Sound Alarm: Big Business Has Captured the Global Health System
articles.summary: Physicians and scientists are openly challenging the profit-driven dominance of Big Business over healthcare, with India's Supreme Court itself calling out exorbitant drug pricing and margins. The piece names the structural corruption baked into pricing, clinical priorities, and treatment access. When courts start saying what doctors have whispered for decades, the suppression dam is breaking.

articles.title: Martin Shkreli Allegedly Traded 60+ Pharma Stocks Despite Lifetime Ban — FTC Wants Him Held in Contempt
articles.summary: The FTC and seven states allege that 'Pharma Bro' Martin Shkreli has been quietly trading stocks in at least 60 pharmaceutical companies in direct violation of a lifetime industry ban imposed after his fraud conviction. Federal authorities are seeking contempt sanctions and forfeiture of all trading profits. It's a window into how pharma insiders treat legal accountability as a speed bump, not a stop sign.

The finding directly challenges blanket clinical prohibitions that have denied immunocompromised patients protection for decades. The medical establishment's refusal to update guidelines based on evidence is itself a patient safety failure.

articles.summary: An analysis of nearly half a million cells from pancreatic cancer patients reveals that tumor cells are in a constant state of genetic evolution, actively reshaping their makeup to evade chemotherapy and metastasize. The research exposes a fundamental failure in how oncology targets static snapshots of tumors rather than their dynamic, adaptive biology. Metabolic and evolutionary cancer theories suppressed for decades may hold more answers than the trillion-dollar chemo paradigm.

articles.title: Rand Paul Formally Demands DOJ Probe Fauci for Perjury Over Gain-of-Function Testimony
articles.summary: Senator Rand Paul has submitted a formal request to the Department of Justice to investigate Anthony Fauci for alleged perjury during 2021 congressional testimony in which Fauci denied NIH funding of gain-of-function research — a claim contradicted by documented grant records. If the DOJ acts, it would mark the first criminal referral against the former NIAID director over COVID-19 origins. The implications stretch beyond Fauci: this is an indictment of the institutional cover-up that suppressed the lab-leak hypothesis for years.

When profit-driven telehealth platforms mislead patients and investors simultaneously, nobody wins except the executives.
